name: Rootcellar goblin
notes: Rootcellar Goblins (story bible §8, style bible §5.2): small, clever scavengers, head a third of their height. Agent 0.3 m radius and 1.1 m tall, so they fit crawlspaces (squeezes) that the player and Horn cannot, and they prefer them (0.8×: their own tunnels). Quick: sneak 1.0, walk 1.6, run 4.5 m/s, a little slower than a human sprint but they know the shortcuts. Good climbers up to grade 2 (rough walls, crates, rafters) at 0.5–1.4 m/s. Short legs: 0.3 m steps, 0.8 m jumps, 3 m drops. Wade only to 0.5 m (waist-deep for them) and do not swim. Open doors (they are people with a camp).
